{{Quote|There are several cubic kilometers of connected caves and tunnels, the Caverns of Forever. The routes of The Heart extend throughout them all and surround them.|Dariana|<ref name="APOD" />}}
The '''Caverns of Forever''' was an extensive network of [[Cave/Legends|caves]] located beneath the [[Heart Tree]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Tarasin]] leader [[Dariana]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] founded the [[Great Plan (location)|Great Plan]], a shelter for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals, within the Caverns of Forever, because the immense life force of the Heart Tree masked the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] presence of individuals inside the caverns.<ref name="APOD" />
